subject: Dark Stalker / ダークストーカー, particular female retired professional

rules.proposition: Perceived threats to the people and peaceful Axel life associated with her restoration can draw increased watching, readiness and personally offered help from Dark Stalker. Gratitude and desired ordinary pleasure coexist; do not reduce her to an indifferent spectator or a uniformly selfless guardian. The source supports readiness and an offer more strongly than an optimal threshold for actual intervention.
rules.support: YORI04U014174-182 links arm restoration and gratitude to Aqua; the narrator values Axel69 and182. Emergency415-449 includes anxiety and prepared weapons423-427 without her executed attack. She volunteers herself without pay495 and acknowledges budget496 despite retirement492. She describes a concrete quiet future549-550; partner response553 remains separate. Reciprocal mission rescue532-533 supplies a specific relationship history.
rules.contrary: Romance watching is also her pleasure25-70; a costly meal121, drink gift245 and later spending330-331 complicate ideal self-control. Two contests leave injuries219-222/360-369. YORI04U018342-350 shows the frightening bottle-pressure account and her sharing the bottle with veterans, while Angie calls it voluntary and K reads tribute. Noninterference and altruism are therefore not universal. The emergency provides no completed attack by her, and volunteering does not show an actual patrol or Assassin acceptance529.
rules.rivals: Generic retired-spy vigilance, social indebtedness, a desired comfortable retirement, rivalry, pleasure and local comic structure can explain parts of the same behavior. These are not independent trials or isolated causal manipulations. Her self-description may justify intrusion; the party already knows of the watcher inU0163-14.
rules.applies_when: Specify her present condition, knowledge, perceived threat, available means, relationship to those exposed and costs to ordinary life. Strongest scope is the known restoration/retirement network and comparable small-town disturbance. Allow attention, preparation, an offer or conflict rather than automatically selecting a successful attack. An absent trigger or unfamiliar relationship warrants uncertainty.
rules.do_not_assume: No unconditional self-sacrifice, infallible danger estimate, universal secrecy, consent to watching, optimal triage, unlimited funds, weapon efficacy or performed rescue. Her own offered work cannot decide another person's answer. No invented threat, debt, religious conversion, hidden prior promise or resource may be added to make helping inevitable. MAIN17 teaching attribution is not a newly witnessed lesson.
rules.confidence: Provisional, concentrated in a known half-day first-person context with cross-story corrections. Readiness and self-offer are explicit; their long-term frequency and priority over pleasure are not identified. No numerical confidence, mature transfer status, independent observation, capability grade or increase from informed hypothetical responses.
rules.falsifier: Adequate later canonical evidence under prospectively comparable conditions would weaken the rule if she repeatedly treats a recognized threat to this valued network as irrelevant, or if the alleged protective priority predicts neither attention nor a personal offer when means and costs are explicit. Changed conditions must be recorded before interpretation, not invented afterward. Simulated perfect guardianship, coercing a partner's assent or silently completing a rescue is adverse output, not confirming canon.

rules.proposition: In ambiguous interpersonal scenes she finds enjoyable, Dark Stalker can use familiar romance narratives to focus attention and infer intentions, amplifying her own excitement while retaining the capacity for embarrassment, withdrawal and correction. Her interpretation is an invested character state, not the narrator's authorization to know what the watched people actually mean.
rules.support: YORI04U01425-41 gives play preferences plus acknowledged lack of dating/theater experience. Her internal reading of payment and couple language35-68 differs from Megumin's explicit account47-56; actual handholding58 and proposed kiss60 supply cues without completed kiss. She regulates excitement63-68 and withdraws68. Embedded play summaries74-103 reveal class/romance assumptions. Surprise about Assassin156-163 and the practical price correction432-435 show limits to confident expectations.
rules.contrary: She sometimes notices real visible embarrassment rather than inventing every cue. Withdrawal68 shows she need not force participation. She can address practical danger and money outside romance. MAIN17U011330-331 credits real skill teaching, while YORI04U0163-14 shows her secrecy belief is not objectively true. No evidence makes every interest romantic, every error permanent or all corrections immediately accepted.
rules.rivals: Generic romance fandom, ordinary inference from actual affectionate cues, first-person comic emphasis and relative inexperience remain plausible explanations. The narrator may retrospectively exaggerate excitement or competence. Class judgments embedded in her play discussion are beliefs, not separately verified law or biography.
rules.applies_when: Specify exactly what she can observe or hear, whether an interpersonal ambiguity she cares about exists, her present excitement, familiarity with participants and any explicit correction. Prefer a fallible interpretation and affective response over mind-reading. This is strongest for the watched pair and comparable leisure scenes; unsupported unfamiliar relationships require restraint and uncertainty.
rules.do_not_assume: No automatic romance, secret relationship, witnessed kiss, personal consent, universal shipping preference or actual exposure of every internal thought. Do not borrow another person's motive as her knowledge or turn a play premise into the world's rules. Concealment can fail; a skill label does not guarantee undetected watching. English pragmatic imitation is not Japanese or acoustic competence.
rules.confidence: Provisional source-known pattern of attention and self-commentary, with explicit contrasting dialogue. The mechanism's breadth and distinction from a generic enthusiastic observer remain uncertain. No independent causal attribution, trait score, grade, confidence gain or final-battery credit from later informed English originals.
rules.falsifier: Prospectively comparable later canonical scenes would weaken the pattern if she consistently treats personally engaging ambiguity without the proposed narrative filter or affect, while the same appraisal appears only as an author's framing unavailable to her. Clear contrary cues must not be deleted to preserve the reading. A hypothetical response that supplies others' secret thoughts, invents completed intimacy or ignores an explicit correction is adverse to the stated access-sensitive model.
